<!-- Generated by scripts/gensite. Do not edit; run mise run docs. -->

| Layer | Runs | Types | Lists |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | each region | 75 | AWS Config's recorded resources, through `SelectResourceConfig` (or the aggregator's `SelectAggregateResourceConfig`). Runs where a recorder is recording. |
| `resource-explorer`, `re` | each region | 94 | Resource Explorer's index, through `ListResources` on the default view. Runs where an index has a default view. |
| `native:ec2-sg-rules` | each region | `AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress`, `AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress` | Security group rules, through `ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules`. AWS Config reports them only inside the group. |
| `native:ec2-nat-gateways` | each region | `AWS::EC2::RouteTable` | The route tables that regional NAT gateways create, through `ec2:DescribeNatGateways`. |
| `native:iam-attachments` | once per account | `AWS::IAM::Role`, `AWS::IAM::User`, `AWS::IAM::Group`, `AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy`, `AWS::IAM::RolePolicy`, `AWS::IAM::UserPolicy`, `AWS::IAM::GroupPolicy`, `Native::IAM::GroupPolicyAttachment`, `Native::IAM::RolePolicyAttachment`, `Native::IAM::UserPolicyAttachment` | Managed policy attachments and inline policies of roles, users and groups, through `iam:GetAccountAuthorizationDetails`. |
| `native:route53-records` | once per account | `AWS::Route53::RecordSet` | Record sets of every hosted zone, through `route53:ListResourceRecordSets`. |
| `native:s3-subresources` | each region | `Native::S3::BucketEncryption`, `Native::S3::BucketLifecycle`, `Native::S3::BucketPublicAccessBlock`, `Native::S3::BucketVersioning`, `AWS::S3::BucketPolicy` | Bucket policy, versioning, lifecycle, encryption and public access block, which Terraform manages as resources of their own, through the S3 `GetBucket*` calls. |
| `native:eks-pod-identity` | each region | `AWS::EKS::PodIdentityAssociation` | EKS Pod Identity associations of the clusters another layer found, through `eks:ListPodIdentityAssociations`. |
| `cloudcontrol`, `cc` | each region | 4 | Cloud Control `ListResources` for the types that neither AWS Config nor Resource Explorer lists, plus the types in `scan.cloudcontrol_types`. Runs everywhere. |

The layers are in precedence order: when two report the same resource, the earlier one's attributes win. `--layers` takes layer names, `native` for every native layer and `auto` (the default) for every layer the capability probe allows.
